thread:
zoe: Hey — accepted the org invite but trying to push to redwood-inference/models gives 403. Invite said SSO via company IdP (Okta). I clicked the link and it showed success. Anyone know where to check SAML provisioning / SCIM mapping?
matt: Welcome! Quick checks: did you sign into the GitHub web UI with your work email, and what does `ssh -T git@github.com` return? Also look for the purple SSO banner on the org page.
zoe: `ssh -T` returns "Hi zoe.personal! You've successfully authenticated." Uh. I definitely signed into GH with zoe@redwood.com and accepted SSO. Push error: `remote: error: GH006` then `fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/': The requested URL returned error: 403`.
idp-bot: SAML status for zoe@redwood.com: account exists, SSO enabled, SCIM provisioning: no matching groups found. last-sync: 2024-11-02T09:10Z.
matt: If SCIM didn't map your teams, you won't get repo permissions. Also the SSH identity shows your personal account — GH can have multiple accounts even if they share emails. Run `gh api user` to see which account the CLI is using.
zoe: `gh api user` shows: `login: zoe_personal`. Yikes. How should I proceed — merge accounts or claim the work account?
devex: Two paths: (A) quick unblock: we can add your current account to a temp team for the repos you need (short-lived), (B) proper fix: create a clean work GitHub account (different username) tied to zoe@redwood.com and have people-ops or GitHub support de-dupe/transfer data. Merging is slower. Which do you prefer?
harper: I can add temp access once devex confirms scope. Note we prefer everyone on a SAML-provisioned account long-term for auditing.
zoe: Temp access please — need to push a small starter change. I'll create a work account today and open a people-ops ticket.
matt: Added `models-contrib-temp` team for 2 hours. Try pushing again.
zoe: Push worked! Thank you. Filing people-ops ticket now. Also suggesting we update onboarding email to warn folks: "If you've previously used your work email on a personal GitHub account, either create a new work account or contact people-ops to avoid SSO/SCIM mismatch."
idp-bot: Reminder: org SSO enforced. SCIM syncs periodically (~5 min). Internal guide: https://redwood-inference.internal/onboarding/github-sso
zoe: Filed the ticket and creating the new work account. All unblocked for now, appreciate the quick help!
